items.headline: SK Hynix stock sees record plunge in Korea despite impressive Nasdaq debut
items.snippet: SK Hynix (SKHYV, SKHY) made its impressive Nasdaq (^IXIC) debut on Friday, but the South Korean shares (000660.KS) are now plunging. Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré and AInvest managing editor Adam Shapiro chat with Morning Brief host Julie Hyman about the company's market moves and earnings outlook.

items.headline: After a Stock Split, Is Now the Right Time to Buy CrowdStrike Stock?
items.snippet: CrowdStrike's stock has been strong, helped by accelerating ARR growth and a stock split.

items.headline: Tesla Stock Isn’t Cheap Anymore. Buy, Sell or Hold?
items.snippet: Tesla just posted its strongest earnings inflection in years, yet the stock sits at a valuation that prices in a future most investors have never seen before. The real question is whether that future arrives on schedule or falls apart in Q2.

items.headline: Is AI Running Out Of Money?
items.snippet: Tech giants are borrowing at a pace that would have seemed unthinkable just a few years ago, betting that AI revenues will eventually justify the load. But skeptical investors, blocked construction projects, and corporate silence about real returns are raising questions the industry does not yet have answers for.

items.headline: Amazon Cut 16,000 Jobs While Bezos Predicts AI Will Create a Labor Shortage
items.snippet: Jeff Bezos just told a Paris crowd that AI will cause a labor shortage, five months after his own company cited AI to justify cutting thousands of jobs. The contradiction runs deeper than it looks.

items.headline: Intel, AMD, and Applied Materials Drop 4% as SK Hynix Rout and Oil Spike Hit Chip Stocks
items.snippet: A surprise profit warning out of South Korea sent shockwaves through the chip sector Monday, and the fallout is hitting equipment makers and AI hardware names in ways that point to a much bigger risk lurking beneath a historic rally.

items.headline: The Market Cap for Jensen Huang's Nvidia Climbs Past $5 Trillion as Reports of a Kyber Delay Are Dismissed
items.snippet: Nvidia is still the engine that makes AI run, but it's becoming increasingly difficult for it to sustain a stock price rally.

items.headline: Prediction: This Will Be Palantir Technologies' Stock Price in 2030
items.snippet: Palantir Technologies stock may be expensive right now, but its growing share of the AI software platforms market points toward substantial upside.

items.headline: Forget Hyperscalers: Here Are the AI Gold Rush Winners to Buy Now
items.snippet: While the biggest names in tech burn through a historic spending spree, a small cluster of suppliers is quietly printing cash at a pace that has no precedent in this industry. Understanding who wins at each stage of the AI cycle could completely change how you position your portfolio.

items.headline: 5 Strong Dividend Stocks You Can Buy Right Now
items.snippet: Chasing high yields in mid-2026 is easy. Finding dividends that businesses can actually sustain is the harder problem, and these five names across REITs, midstream, and fintech clear that bar while still offering yields near 5%.
